title: Classify GRC Artifacts
prompt: For each description, choose the artifact category: Policy, Standard, Procedure, or Plan. Reason based on the question the document answers, not its title.

items.label: AUP: defines acceptable uses of workstations and the Internet
BYOD: personal devices must be registered before any access
Classification and retention: contracts are retained for 7 years
Privacy: customer data is not sold to third parties
All data at rest must be encrypted with AES-256
Windows hardening baseline: unnecessary services disabled
SOP: steps to revoke an account upon employee departure
Runbook: restart the messaging service and check the queue
SOP: handling a temporary access request and its review
BCP: maintaining critical operations during a disruption
DRP: restoring systems at the hot recovery site

explain: Policy = high-level mandatory intent; standard = measurable minimum requirement; procedure = repeatable step-by-step instructions; plan = organizing continuity or recovery. A baseline is a configuration standard, not just a recommendation.
